Getting the Frame Right

Topic 1 of 2

Why the frame comes first

Before anything moves, decide what the viewer is allowed to see. The marmalade-sandwich rule: one subject, one edge, one reason to look.

A frame is a promise about what matters.
  • Pick the subject
  • Pick the edge
  • Hold for a breath longer than is comfortable
